limitations: The characteristic-sensitive table is proved only for the six-dimensional quotient by the cube of the maximal ideal. All-field proof is symbolic; finite checks are corroborative. Unlocated equivalent literature is an originality risk.
scientific_integrity: A direct proof of an ideal-lattice orbit-and-incidence classification for one Artinian local algebra; classical projective geometry is credited and independent audit is not claimed.
title: Twelve ideal-lattice orbits and their characteristic-sensitive incidences in a short local algebra
